title: diplactis tongolensis
intro: Diplactis tongolensis, commonly known as Tongkat Ali, is a plant species that belongs to the Eurycoma genus of flowering plants. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fatigue, stress, and low libido, due to its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as improving physical performance, enhancing cognitive function, and reducing anxiety. Diplactis tongolensis is rich in bioactive constituents, including eurycomanone, eurycomanin, and eurycomanol, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
